name: mail-kit
description: One transactional email design for every tool, themed per tool: theme and blocks in, subject, html and text out.

scripts.test:worker: node test/consumers/prepare.ts worker && vitest run --root test/consumers/worker
scripts.test:node22: node test/consumers/prepare.ts node && npx -y node@22.23.5 -p "'node ' + process.version" && npx -y node@22.23.5 --test "test/consumers/node/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:assumptions: npm install --prefix test/assumptions/worker-file-dep --no-package-lock && vitest run --root test/assumptions/worker-file-dep && node test/assumptions/color-scheme.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:worker && npm run test:node && npm run test:node22 && npm run preview && npm run test:mockup
